title: The Shooting Gallery
text: Masked crossbowmen lean from a gallery above the street and shoot at anyone who walks below, for sport, laughing behind their blank faces. The cobbles are bristling with bolts. The street is the only way through.

options.label: The one who draws every bolt runs the street first, so the rest may follow.

outcomes.text: Every bolt goes after them, and misses, and the masks applaud.

options.label: The one with the poorest eye walks it slowly, unafraid of what they cannot see.

outcomes.text: The masks are so puzzled they forget to shoot.

options.label: The one with the hurt arm holds a shield over the rest. It is hurt already.

outcomes.text: The rest cross under cover. The shield bearer catches up last, bruised, with the shield full of bolts.
